title: OLX.ba Market Overview
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event timestamps rather than reconstructed daily inventory.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __value FROM lean.saved_searches WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: rooms
filters.label: Rooms
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(rooms,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

filters.name: neighborhood
filters.label: Neighborhood
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(neighborhood,'unknown') AS __value FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active listings
panels.sql:
WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal} = 'All' OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lean.saved_searches ss WHERE ss.search_key = ANY(l.search_keys) AND ss.category = ${category})) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT count(*) AS active,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_seen >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7) AS new_7d,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) FILTER (WHERE deal='sale' AND ppm2>0)::numeric,0) AS median_sale_ppm2,
  round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY price) FILTER (WHERE deal='rent' AND price>0)::numeric,0) AS median_rent
FROM base

panels.title: Price cuts · 7 d
panels.description: Active listings with a recorded price cut in the last 7 days.
panels.sql: WITH prices AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, price, lag(price) OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY price_date, id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND source='api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price, previous_price - price AS reduction FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT count(DISTINCT c.article_id) AS drops FROM cuts c JOIN lean.listings l USING(article_id) WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal} = 'All' OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lean.saved_searches ss WHERE ss.search_key = ANY(l.search_keys) AND ss.category = ${category})) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND c.price_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 7

panels.title: Median price cut
panels.description: Across every recorded cut, active or closed, regardless of filters.
panels.sql: WITH prices AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, price, lag(price) OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY price_date, id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND source='api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price, previous_price - price AS reduction FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY reduction)::numeric,0) AS median_cut FROM cuts WHERE reduction>0

panels.title: Sale asking price per m² · daily
panels.description: Median and interquartile range across sale listings active at each day's end. Each listing carries its latest reported price; historical KM/m² uses current area.
panels.sql:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(date(${time_from} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date - 89) AS start_day,
         LEAST(date(${time_to} AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo'), (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo')::date) AS end_day
), sale_listings AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT article_id, sqm, first_seen
  FROM lean.listings
  WHERE deal = 'sale' AND sqm > 0
), openings AS (
  SELECT article_id, first_seen AS opened_at FROM sale_listings
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.article_id, e.occurred_at AS opened_at
  FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
  JOIN sale_listings s USING (article_id)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'reopened'
), cycles AS (
  SELECT o.article_id, o.opened_at, c.closed_at
  FROM openings o
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT min(e.occurred_at) AS closed_at
    FROM lean.listing_lifecycle_events e
    WHERE e.article_id = o.article_id
      AND e.event_type = 'closed'
      AND e.occurred_at > o.opened_at
  ) c ON TRUE
), prior_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM sale_listings s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date < bounds.start_day
    ORDER BY ph.price_date DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) price
), window_prices AS (
  SELECT s.article_id, price.price, price.price_date
  FROM sale_listings s
  CROSS JOIN bounds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ph.price, ph.price_date
    FROM lean.price_history ph
    WHERE ph.article_id = s.article_id
      AND ph.source = 'api_price_history'
      AND ph.price > 0
      AND ph.price_date BETWEEN bounds.start_day AND bounds.end_day
  ) price
), price_spans AS (
  SELECT relevant.article_id, relevant.price, relevant.price_date,
         lead(relevant.price_date) OVER (
           PARTITION BY relevant.article_id ORDER BY relevant.price_date
         ) AS next_date
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM prior_prices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM window_prices
  ) relevant
), daily AS (
  SELECT d.day::date AS day, p.price / NULLIF(l.sqm, 0) AS ppm2
  FROM price_spans p
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    GREATEST(p.price_date, b.start_day),
    LEAST(COALESCE(p.next_date - 1, b.end_day), b.end_day),
    INTERVAL '1 day'
  ) AS d(day) ON TRUE
  JOIN cycles c
    ON c.article_id = p.article_id
   AND c.opened_at < d.day::date + 1
   AND (c.closed_at IS NULL OR c.closed_at >= d.day::date + 1)
  JOIN sale_listings l ON l.article_id = c.article_id
)
SELECT day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Sarajevo' AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p25,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS median,
       percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ppm2) AS p75,
       count(*) AS listings
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Recent price cuts
panels.sql: WITH prices AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, price, lag(price) OVER (PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY price_date, id) AS previous_price FROM lean.price_history WHERE price IS NOT NULL AND source='api_price_history'), cuts AS (SELECT article_id, price_date, previous_price, price, previous_price - price AS reduction FROM prices WHERE previous_price > price) SELECT l.title,l.url,c.previous_price AS was,c.price AS now,c.reduction,c.price_date FROM cuts c JOIN lean.listings l USING(article_id) WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal} = 'All' OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lean.saved_searches ss WHERE ss.search_key = ANY(l.search_keys) AND ss.category = ${category})) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric) ORDER BY c.price_date DESC LIMIT 25

panels.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT l.* FROM lean.listings l WHERE l.closed_at IS NULL AND (${deal} = 'All' OR l.deal = CASE WHEN ${deal} = 'sell' THEN 'sale' ELSE ${deal} END) AND (${rooms} = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.rooms,'unknown') = ${rooms}) AND ('All' = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[]) OR COALESCE(l.neighborhood,'unknown') = ANY (ARRAY[${neighborhood}]::text[])) AND (${category} = 'All' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lean.saved_searches ss WHERE ss.search_key = ANY(l.search_keys) AND ss.category = ${category})) AND (NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm >= NULLIF(${min_sqm}, '')::numeric) AND (NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric IS NULL OR l.sqm <= NULLIF(${max_sqm}, '')::numeric)) SELECT title,url,(extra->>'views')::numeric AS views,sqm,rooms,price FROM base WHERE extra->>'views' ~ '^[0-9]+$' ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 25
